about: Oneway's changelog (founder/870): one entry per big update, newest first. date is the day (YYYY-MM-DD); words are the founder's. An entry may also have a title and sections, each a title and a list of items (founder/1024). A line marked as pending is not live yet: tools/landing_static.py leaves it out of the published page and file until the mark is cleared. changelog.html is drawn from this file; adding an entry needs no change to the page.

entries.title: November update — Profiles, Messages and operating tools
entries.words: A consolidated update bringing recent profile, Discovery and operating-tool work together, with everyday fixes and security hardening.

sections.title: Emergency browser repair
items: Restored full App styling and navigation after a release-build failure, including Discovery map styles.
Fixed the OS menu failing on a fresh Home load.
Embedded videos wait for their card layout before loading instead of being permanently replaced by a link. Existing playback choices and provider restrictions still apply.

sections.title: Profiles and everyday use
items: Names use the reading font while custom wordmarks retain their own lettering.
Profile pages can be added straight from the page bar with an automatic name, then renamed or arranged through the existing editor.
Home's Add menu brings the available widgets together in their existing categories.

Reading a conversation clears its unread count in the conversation list and Messages navigation, including other open tabs. Messages arriving while the conversation is in the background remain unread.
Home feed pages and less-used operating tools load when opened, reducing the initial download.

sections.title: Discovery and media
items: Photos keep their correct orientation in JPEG, PNG and WebP originals and generated sizes. Rotated WebP originals are stored upright for browsers that ignore rotation metadata; image preparation stays bounded.
Map place markers retain their category colours in both map styles.
Supported fonts, maps and display libraries are served through Oneway's own origin. Picture requests are bounded and legal picture holds also cover cached server copies.
Feed pictures retain their aspect ratio while loading, and desktop feed media use the shared media controls.

sections.title: Operating tools
items: Hotel work includes room-unit and desk refinements, morning exports, safer queued actions, checkout thank-you handling and complimentary-ticket capacity handling.
Restaurant tools include recipe-linked stock availability, receiving, pars and host/pre-service refinements.
Pickup payments retain the paid-order fence while operating records catch up, preventing a second checkout during that interval.
Connected-work records and the marketing board identify where an item was sent, imported, disconnected or closed.
Marketing segments respect recorded opt-outs and verified delivery-provider suppression events.
Business signup, founding, claim and plan-return flows share the existing account and payment controls.

sections.title: Account and security
items: Passkeys require user verification and are bound to the account, origin and sign-in challenge.
Personal automatic Centers stay out of public speaking identities while explicit memberships remain available.
Session, shared-canvas, import, booking and outbound-request checks are tightened.
Exporting the entire customer list requires the existing higher-trust approval.
Requests to speak to a human pause an automatic keyword reply.

entries.title: v50.1 — Discovery and everyday tools
entries.words: A follow-up to v50 focused on finding places, filling in the map, browsing as a guest, and keeping everyday tools together.

sections.title: Discovery and places
items: Searchable map places open as Information Centers, including places whose community information has not been filled in yet.
Imported places and places added by people use the same Center records. Finding an existing match opens that Center instead of creating another copy.
Nearby places needing information appear in Explore and Contribute without relying on a town Center. The list states its area and when it is only a selection.
Add an introduction with a short write, review and confirmation flow. Current information is read before editing it.
Public information changes reach other signed-in viewers through live updates. Open pages retain their follow and post controls.
Map-place links survive a reload. Both the vector map and basic renderer can open indexed places from a map tap.

More place categories can appear on the map, with icons appearing at wider zoom levels. Recorded follows and post counts help active places stand out in crowded views, regardless of ownership or Center type.
Information Centers use category artwork and an information marker; adding a picture keeps the category marker in the corner.
Imported searchable-place coverage currently includes the supported US regions; missing coverage is stated rather than shown as an empty area.
Map places missing from the separate search inventory resolve against the actual map source, preserving verified names and points instead of rejecting the place.

sections.title: Location and Waypass
items: Location sharing has an explicit save action and confirmed status. Starting sharing returns to the map, shows your position and follows fresh fixes; hiding other people keeps your own marker visible.
Your location marker moves smoothly between fresh device fixes. Moving around the map pauses camera-follow, and recentering resumes it.
Stale locations are marked as last known positions. Watching your own location does not turn on public location sharing.

Waypass is opt-in for adults and uses the selected device. Two people who both turned it on swap cards when they are really near each other, about 150 metres, at the same moment, and are both told at once a few minutes later, with a place name and a time rather than coordinates. On the web it counts while the page is open.

sections.title: Guests and profiles
items: Open the App from the website and browse public Home and the map without signing in.
Guest likes count toward the real total. Guests can undo their like, while comments, posting, following and negative reactions remain sign-in actions.
Eligible visitors can post as themselves at unclaimed Information Centers without becoming members or gaining authority over the place.
Simple public profiles put identity, links and posts together without a redundant Profile view. Their first public posts load from the existing profile read.

sections.title: Workspace, Opportunities and refinements
items: Workspace brings together the existing Calendar, email tools and connected business workspace.
Opportunities is the destination for the Marketplace, jobs and bookable spaces. Tonight near you appears in Discovery.
Calendar views, destination links and phone layouts received additional checks across light, dark and simple presentation.
Activity colours, server-rendered icons, link insertion and permission checks received targeted fixes. The boost engine remains disabled; this update does not announce active boosting.

entries.title: v50
entries.words: A big update across Oneway: new safety tools, more privacy choices, and new things in the App and for businesses.

sections.title: Safety and security
items: Your account is protected at every step: sign-in, two-step verification, passkeys, and the devices you are signed in on, which you can see and sign out of in Settings.
Every post, comment, message, bio and listing passes Oneway's safety check before it shows, so threats, hate and harmful content never reach anyone.
Community reports are taken seriously: when several trusted people report the same thing, it is hidden until our team decides.
Oneway watches for unusual activity around the clock and responds on its own to things like spam floods, password guessing and automated scraping.
Our team has a dedicated safety console, and one switch can tighten the whole platform whenever it is needed.
Photos and files are checked before they are stored, and a link in a post always shows exactly where it goes.
Anyone can ask for an intimate picture shared without consent to be taken down, and every copy of it is removed.
Bookings and checkouts are protected from bots and floods, so real people always get through.

sections.title: Privacy
items: Your email address is never shown to anyone else, anywhere on Oneway.
A private profile stays private everywhere its posts could appear.
Choose who sees when you are online: everyone, the people you follow back, or nobody.
Choose how comments with strong words appear to you: shown, blurred with a tap to see, or hidden. Keep your own list of words you never want to see.
An edited post says Edited, and only you decide whether others can see what you first wrote.
Teen accounts get extra care: a teen's location is shared only with friends, and teens are told clearly what a teen account means.
You can change your birthday once in Settings, with a clear check before it is saved.

sections.title: New in the App
items: Edit opens the page editor right on your profile or your Center's page. Changes stay a draft until you press Publish, and History keeps your past versions.
Free placement: every piece stays exactly where you put it, pieces can overlap, and nothing pushes anything else around.
The Marketplace: list an item, people nearby find it and message you, and the chat suggests safe public places and times to meet.
Every post and card on Home wears its author's own colour, a person's or a Center's.
Discovery's map turns with two fingers like Apple Maps, with a compass, and shows the places near you as cards.
Home is faster, and Messages, Create and Me come back exactly as you left them.
Follower and following counts are live and exact everywhere, and links in posts can be tapped.
Twelve month colours in themes, smooth light and dark mode that follows your device, and one icon set with over 1,500 icons.

sections.title: For Centers and businesses
items: Book a table or a room right on a Center's own website, with a confirmation email, a calendar file and a link to change or cancel.
Tickets show the truth: free tickets say Free, seats are held fairly, and events read the same everywhere.
Join a Center's rewards with one press, and the card lands in your wallet.
Selling on Oneway costs a simple 1% fee, with a 10-cent minimum.
Arrange a Center's pages into categories that open and close, and choose who sees each one.
Choose exactly which Facebook Page, Instagram account or Google listing your Center connects.
Oneway OS has a new home screen: what is happening now, today's figures and a tile for each System.

sections.title: The website
items: The landing's headline line is new, Oneway OS is marked coming soon on the Business OS pages and every System page, and the footer has a Discovery page and this changelog.

entries.words: Discovery became its own app inside Oneway, with Waypass and Near here. Messages, notifications and team chat were rebuilt, profiles got one clean layout, Lightbulb got a new camera and drafts, and the App and the OS can now be opened and closed from oneway.center itself.
Platform servers have been put live for the first time, and the first App and landing tests began with pleasant results. We have already started work on the next fix to make Oneway even better.
